text: Eighty percent you regret this tomorrow!
note: Shouting over loud club music, grinning, means it, a friend calling the odds while he films.
sub: Eighty percent you regret this tomorrow.

text: Theo. I have never regretted one thing in my life.
note: Delighted, mid-dance, a little drunk and completely sure, loud enough to be heard over the music, savoring "never".
Deflated in one breath, quiet and honest, the music still going around him.
Moved, quiet, sincere and a bit choked up, squinting at the floor.
Thrilled, leaning in over the music, like she has found the best thing in the club.
Honest and flat, still looking at the floor, not a joke to him.
Standing, arms up, shouting to the whole club, ecstatic.
A crowd chanting back as one, on the beat. Several voices layered.
Sincere and gentle, close, a small smile, she just found it.
Quiet, a little proud, deciding something, then a half smile on "them".
Morning, hungover, deadly serious, low and dry, to the viewer.

text: Theo took it. It's in my album.
note: Dry, holding up the phone, proud. Long cut only.

text: This my app. Go download pixie.
note: Easy and charming, one brow up, holding the phone to the viewer.
sub: This my app. Go download PXI.
